title: Ghost Meridian
prompt: drum n bass, uk garage, fred again, joy orbison, skrillex
description: A heads-down late-night UKG journey built on warm sub-bass and a shuffled TR909 2-step, opening in near-darkness before gradually unfurling layers of ghostly chord stabs and swinging hats. The groove deepens through the middle with syncopated synth riffs and a breathing filter sweep, then strips back to a cool, understated close — always moving, never forcing it.
